stemMd: Suppose the additional condition is: North must be in position 1. Which further statement must then be true?

options.label: B
options.textMd: North must not be in position 1.

options.label: D
options.textMd: North and South must not occupy consecutive positions.

explanationMd:
First restrict attention to orders satisfying the extra condition as well as the original rules. There are 1 such orders. "North and South must not occupy consecutive positions." holds throughout this restricted set; the other statements fail on the explicit examples in their feedback.

The remaining orders are:
- North → West → Central → South → East

distractorRationale.b: Even with the additional condition, North → West → Central → South → East is permitted and makes this statement false.
distractorRationale.c: Even with the additional condition, North → West → Central → South → East is permitted and makes this statement false.
distractorRationale.a: Even with the additional condition, North → West → Central → South → East is permitted and makes this statement false.
